$comment: Staff directory from two official BIA documents approved by Boma (Oct 2026): "BIA Staff Job Descriptions and Responsibilities" and "BIA Management Roles and Responsibilities". Text is reproduced from the documents; departments are a grouping for the website only and do not describe reporting lines. No photos, qualifications or contact details are recorded here.

sections.heading: Responsibilities
items: Oversees academic operations, including classes and tutorials, ensuring delivery is coordinated and progress is monitored.
Monitors operational plans, targets, schedules, and follow-through across academic and programme activities.
Tracks progress, identifies issues or delays, and escalates matters requiring management attention.
Coordinates operational information and supports accurate, evidence-based reporting.

sections.heading: Responsibilities
items: Oversees general administration, office services, and non-academic service delivery.
Coordinates front-office functions, enquiries, administrative records, and routine office procedures.
Monitors facilities and resource needs, and follows up on service or maintenance issues.
Coordinates assigned administrative staff and reports outstanding issues or decisions needed.

people.name: Grace Damaris Igbani
people.title: Acting Personal Assistant to the CEO / Public Relations Officer (PRO)
people.summary: This position supports the CEO’s daily coordination needs while also helping BIA communicate clearly with students and its wider audience.

sections.heading: Acting Personal Assistant to the CEO
items: Assist with coordinating the CEO’s activities and day-to-day work arrangements.
Communicate important information to the CEO and to relevant people when required for assigned work.
Follow up on tasks assigned by the CEO, check their progress, and bring pending items to the appropriate person’s attention.
Help keep daily operations organised by supporting coordination and timely communication.
Where a task, instruction, or deadline is unclear, seek clarification rather than making assumptions.

sections.heading: Public Relations Officer
items: Share accurate information about BIA’s programmes, services, activities, and announcements with students and the wider audience.
Help publicise BIA programmes and services through the communication channels assigned to the role.
Support student engagement by responding to or directing questions and comments through the relevant channels.
Help maintain clear, timely, and professional communication between BIA and its students or audience.
Ensure that public-facing information is accurate and raise questions internally when confirmation is needed.

sections.heading: Practical expectations
items: Keep track of assigned follow-ups and communicate progress or unresolved issues.
Coordinate the PA and PRO duties so that important messages and tasks are not overlooked.
Refer matters outside the role’s knowledge or authority to the CEO or the appropriate team member.

people.source: BIA Staff Job Descriptions and Responsibilities (prepared by the Head of Operations)

people.name: Samuel Alice Temiloluwa
people.title: Receptionist
people.summary: The receptionist welcomes visitors, attends to enquiries, supports programme registration, and follows up on registration-related matters.

sections.heading: Reception and enquiries
items: Welcome visitors and attend to questions from prospective students, parents, and existing students.
Provide clear information about registration, admission, payment procedures, and available programmes to the extent confirmed by BIA.
Refer questions that require confirmation to the appropriate staff member rather than guessing.

sections.heading: Registration support
items: Register students for JUPEB and other available programmes using the required process.
Check that the information supplied for registration is recorded carefully and that any missing details are identified for follow-up.
Contact prospective students and parents to explain registration, admission, and payment procedures.

sections.heading: Follow-up and reporting
items: Follow up with students and parents regarding registration fees, outstanding payments, and required documentation.
Prepare daily and weekly reports on work activities, achievements, challenges, and progress.
Ensure that reports communicate the status of work clearly and flag items that need attention.

people.source: BIA Staff Job Descriptions and Responsibilities (prepared by the Head of Operations)

people.name: Adenusi Gloria
people.title: JUPEB Manager / Secretary
people.summary: This role manages key JUPEB administrative processes, including registration, student records, payment records, enquiries, and coordination.

sections.heading: Student registration and onboarding
items: Register new students and record their information accurately.
Guide newly admitted students through the registration and admission process.
Prepare and send students’ registration slips and biodata forms.
Monitor registration progress and follow up when a student’s registration is incomplete.

sections.heading: Student data and documentation
items: Enter, update, organise, and maintain student information in the relevant database or records.
Keep registration records and related documents organised so that information can be located when needed.
Coordinate student records and support proper documentation and accessibility of information.

sections.heading: Payments and receipts
items: Update and maintain students’ payment records.
Issue payment receipts where required and in line with BIA’s process.
Follow up with students regarding outstanding payments and communicate payment-record issues to the appropriate person.

sections.heading: Enquiries and student communication
items: Attend to enquiries from prospective students, registered students, and parents.
Provide accurate information on admission procedures, tuition fees, payment plans, and academic activities.
Communicate important announcements, updates, and information to students.

sections.heading: Accommodation administration
items: Prepare accommodation receipts.
Assist students with accommodation-related enquiries and direct unresolved matters to the appropriate person.

sections.heading: Reports and operational coordination
items: Prepare and maintain records of registered students, payments, and other administrative activities.
Work with other staff members and departments to support effective communication and teamwork.
Support the smooth coordination of JUPEB administrative activities and day-to-day operations.
Ensure students receive timely assistance and administrative tasks are completed efficiently.
Carry out other related administrative duties assigned by management in support of the academy’s operations.

people.source: BIA Staff Job Descriptions and Responsibilities (prepared by the Head of Operations)

people.name: Soretire Ibukunoluwa Aramide
people.title: Secretary / JAMB Manager
people.summary: This role coordinates JAMB classes, supports student verification towards the stated recruitment target, and manages the BIA TikTok page for JAMB candidates.

sections.heading: JAMB class planning and coordination
items: Plan JAMB classes and prepare or coordinate the class timetable.
Message tutors about scheduled classes and confirm whether they are available.
Follow up on class arrangements to help ensure tutors are available as planned.
When a tutor is unavailable, take the class if needed and if able to do so, as described for this role.
Communicate changes or availability issues to the relevant people.

sections.heading: Student verification and target support
items: Verify students as part of the work towards BIA’s stated target for the next JAMB cycle.
Keep the verification process organised and raise unclear or incomplete student information for follow-up.
Help maintain visibility of progress towards the target through the verification work assigned.

sections.heading: BIA JAMB TikTok page
items: Manage the BIA TikTok page intended for JAMB candidates.
Respond to comments from JAMB candidates and prospective students.
Direct interested people to WhatsApp so they can be added to the appropriate groups.
Communicate information accurately and refer questions that require confirmation to the relevant team.

people.source: BIA Staff Job Descriptions and Responsibilities (prepared by the Head of Operations)

people.name: Ibitoye Esther
people.title: Accommodation Manager
people.summary: This role publicises available accommodation, responds to accommodation enquiries, helps arrange inspections, and follows up with prospective clients.

sections.heading: Accommodation publicity
items: Post details of available accommodation in the appropriate accommodation groups.
Prepare a write-up for each listing using the available and confirmed details.
Make sure the information shared reflects the listing details provided and seek clarification when information is missing.

sections.heading: Enquiries and customer service
items: Respond to accommodation enquiries from students and parents.
Provide accurate information about available accommodation and assist with related questions.
Respond to enquiries received through the company website or other communication channels about BIA’s programmes and services, as described for this role.

sections.heading: Hostel inspections
items: Arrange hostel inspections with interested parents or students.
Attend or assist with inspections personally, or coordinate support from another staff member when necessary.
Communicate inspection arrangements clearly to the people involved.

sections.heading: Client follow-up and conversion
items: Provide prospective clients with the information they need about BIA’s programmes and services.
Explain payment procedures using confirmed information.
Follow up with people who have made enquiries and encourage interested prospects to proceed with registration and payment where appropriate.
Refer questions about details outside the role’s knowledge or authority to the appropriate team member.

people.source: BIA Staff Job Descriptions and Responsibilities (prepared by the Head of Operations)

people.name: Williams Favour Ogunbayo
people.title: Online Tutor for Commercial Subjects / Student Outreach Support
people.summary: This role combines online teaching of commercial subjects with student engagement and outreach support.

sections.heading: Online tutoring
items: Teach Economics and Business Studies (BUS) to students in the relevant online subject groups.
Support participation and active learning by engaging students during subject-group learning activities.
Help students understand the topics being taught and respond to subject-related questions within the tutor’s knowledge.
Use the relevant subject groups to keep teaching and student participation organised.

sections.heading: Outreach and student recruitment support
items: When participating in outreach with other staff, speak with prospective students and explain what BIA is and what it offers.
Collect contact numbers from interested students in the course of outreach.
Ensure contact numbers collected are added to the specific groups intended for those students.
Help prospective students understand the available BIA offering accurately and avoid promising anything that has not been confirmed.

people.source: BIA Staff Job Descriptions and Responsibilities (prepared by the Head of Operations)

people.name: Daniel John
people.title: Physical Tutor for CRS, Government and Literature / Student Recruitment and Lecture Bank Support
people.summary: This role provides physical teaching for specified art subjects and supports student recruitment and the organisation of the art class Lecture Bank.

sections.heading: Physical tutoring
items: Teach Christian Religious Studies (CRS), Government, and Literature to students through physical classes.
Support students’ understanding of the subjects and respond to relevant academic questions within the tutor’s knowledge.
Assist with maintaining an effective learning environment during the classes assigned.

sections.heading: Student recruitment
items: Identify and engage prospective JUPEB candidates.
Explain BIA’s available programmes and provide accurate information to interested candidates.
Encourage interested candidates to take the next appropriate step towards enrolment without making unconfirmed promises.

sections.heading: Lecture Bank collation
items: Assist in collecting and collating lecture materials for the organisation’s art class Lecture Bank.
Organise materials so they can be located and used more easily by the relevant people.
Help maintain the Lecture Bank by keeping the materials organised and bringing gaps or missing items to the appropriate person’s attention.

people.source: BIA Staff Job Descriptions and Responsibilities (prepared by the Head of Operations)

people.name: Divine Igbokwe
people.title: Assistant Academic Director / WhatsApp Channel Handler
people.summary: This role supports class scheduling and tutor coordination and manages the BIA WhatsApp Channel’s JAMB-focused content and engagement.

sections.heading: Academic coordination support
items: Assist with scheduling and coordinating classes.
Contact tutors about class arrangements, schedules, and academic activities.
Help confirm tutor availability for scheduled classes and communicate scheduling issues to the appropriate person.

sections.heading: WhatsApp Channel management
items: Manage the BIA WhatsApp Channel and ensure content is updated regularly.
Post JAMB past questions, polls, and answers to support students preparing for their examinations.
Share relevant content across JAMB groups and encourage students to participate.

sections.heading: Content preparation and engagement
items: Work with the editor to prepare JAMB-related content for posting.
Suggest ideas that may improve engagement and participation on the WhatsApp Channel.
Help keep posted educational content clear, relevant, and organised.

people.source: BIA Staff Job Descriptions and Responsibilities (prepared by the Head of Operations)

people.name: Achief Halimat Anuoluwapo (Halima)
people.title: Online Tutor for Art Subjects / Student Outreach Support / Personal Assistant to Sir Holly and the Chief Operating Officer (COO)
people.summary: This role combines online teaching, student outreach and follow-up, and personal-assistant support to Sir Holly and the Chief Operating Officer (COO).

sections.heading: Online tutoring for art students
items: Teach Government, Christian Religious Studies (CRS), and Literature to students in the relevant online subject groups.
Support participation and active learning in the subject groups.
Help students with questions relating to the subjects taught, within the tutor’s knowledge.

sections.heading: Outreach and student follow-up
items: When participating in outreach with other staff, speak with prospective students and explain what BIA is and what it offers.
Collect contact numbers from interested students during outreach.
Ensure the numbers collected are added to the specific groups intended for those students.
Follow up with students after outreach as part of the assigned student-engagement process.
Provide accurate information and refer questions requiring confirmation to the appropriate team member.

sections.heading: Personal Assistant to Sir Holly
items: Remind Sir Holly of BIA-related classes, meetings, and scheduled commitments.
Help keep Sir Holly’s schedule organised and bring upcoming or conflicting commitments to his attention.
Follow up on pending tasks and remind him of items that still require action.
Follow up with other staff members on tasks or matters that Sir Holly has asked to be monitored, and communicate the status back to him.
Keep relevant reminders and follow-up information organised so that commitments and pending tasks are not easily overlooked.

sections.heading: Personal Assistant to the Chief Operating Officer (COO)
items: Support the COO with organising and tracking BIA-related appointments, meetings, and scheduled commitments communicated to the PA.
Remind the COO of upcoming meetings, deadlines, and pending tasks that have been brought to the PA’s attention.
Follow up on assigned action points with the COO or relevant staff members and report back on their status.
Help keep the COO’s schedule and task reminders organised, and promptly flag clashes, changes, or items requiring attention.
Communicate information and reminders accurately, maintain appropriate discretion with work-related information, and seek clarification when instructions are unclear.

sections.heading: Coordination and boundaries
items: Keep teaching, outreach, and PA duties organised so that important responsibilities are not overlooked.
Clarify priorities with Sir Holly or the COO when tasks conflict or the expected deadline is unclear.
Provide reminders and follow-ups; responsibility for making the final decisions or completing another person’s task remains with the person assigned to it unless separately instructed.

people.source: BIA Staff Job Descriptions and Responsibilities (prepared by the Head of Operations)

people.name: Ighofimoni Gabriel Oghenekevwe
people.title: BIA DSA (Directorate of Student Affairs)
people.summary: This role provides student consultation and support, especially through BIA and UNILAG groups and direct messages.

sections.heading: Student consultation and enquiries
items: Attend to students’ questions and enquiries in BIA groups, UNILAG groups, and direct messages.
Review incoming questions and make reasonable efforts to ensure that students receive a response rather than being overlooked.
Provide answers only when the information is known and reliable.
When an answer is uncertain or unavailable, confirm the correct information with Mr. Boma or the relevant team before replying.
Where another staff member or department is better placed to answer, direct the enquiry to that person or seek their input.

sections.heading: Follow-up and communication
items: Keep track of questions that require confirmation and return to the student with the confirmed answer.
Communicate with students respectfully and clearly, including when an answer is still being checked.
Help identify recurring student questions that may need a clearer announcement or explanation from BIA.

people.source: BIA Staff Job Descriptions and Responsibilities (prepared by the Head of Operations)

people.name: Jomiloju Samuel Ayo-Yusuf
people.title: Head of Content Creation / YEB Manager
people.summary: This role coordinates YEB members and content creators and follows up with prospective partners and programme leads.

sections.heading: YEB member management
items: Coordinate the activities of YEB members and keep track of work relating to their responsibilities.
Ensure members have the materials, resources, and support needed for their assigned work, raising resource gaps when necessary.
Support members in carrying out activities intended to generate profit for the company, within the work assigned to them.

sections.heading: Partner and stakeholder follow-up
items: Maintain communication with prospective partners and stakeholders.
Follow up on previous conversations, keep relationships active, and explore potential collaboration opportunities that may benefit the company.
Share relevant updates with the appropriate team members and seek guidance where an offer or commitment requires approval.

sections.heading: Content creator management
items: Coordinate content creators and monitor the development, delivery, and quality of assigned content.
Provide creative ideas and support where needed to help creators complete content effectively.
Identify when creators need additional support or incentives and raise or coordinate those needs through the appropriate process.

sections.heading: BIA JUPEB registration leads
items: Monitor prospective JUPEB applicants who have been identified as leads.
Follow up with those applicants and maintain consistent communication to encourage them to proceed with registration where interested.
Keep relevant lead follow-up information organised and communicate progress or unresolved questions to the appropriate team.

sections.heading: Lecture Bank leads
items: Monitor and follow up with prospective Lecture Bank leads.
Maintain communication with potential collaborators and explore opportunities to expand the network supporting BIA JUPEB programmes.
Share the status of relevant conversations with the appropriate team members.

people.source: BIA Staff Job Descriptions and Responsibilities (prepared by the Head of Operations)

people.name: Nwokwe Onyedikachi (Dominique)
people.title: Assistant Brand Manager / Content Creator
people.summary: This role creates and supports digital content for BIA Academy, with a focus on JUPEB admissions and preparation, online visibility, and prospective-student engagement.

sections.heading: Content development and production
items: Create content for BIA Academy’s social media platforms to promote the brand and increase awareness.
Develop content ideas, scripts, captions, hooks, and video concepts focused on JUPEB admissions and preparation.
Shoot and edit videos for BIA Academy.
Contribute content ideas that support BIA’s online growth.

sections.heading: Brand and creative coordination
items: Work with the Brand Manager to develop creative ideas and strategies that strengthen BIA’s online presence and visibility across digital platforms.
Suggest approaches for promoting BIA and reaching more prospective students.
Coordinate creative work with the Brand Manager so content aligns with the direction agreed for the brand.

sections.heading: Prospective-student enquiries and follow-up
items: Respond to prospective students’ enquiries and provide information about BIA’s JUPEB programmes.
Follow up with prospective students to encourage continued engagement and registration.
Ensure information shared with prospective students is accurate and refer unconfirmed questions to the appropriate team member.

sections.heading: Reporting
items: Prepare daily work reports covering relevant activities and progress.
Share content ideas and relevant updates that support the team’s online growth.

people.source: BIA Staff Job Descriptions and Responsibilities (prepared by the Head of Operations)
